summary: Magna International filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 Financial Review (Exhibit 99.1), Q3 2026 results webcast presentation (Exhibit 99.2) and webcast transcript (Exhibit 99.3), signed by Jason Wolkove, Vice-President, M&A, Capital Markets and Secretary. The exhibits contain quarterly vehicle volume statistics, average FX rates, consolidated income statements and non-GAAP measures (Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBIT, Adjusted ROIC) with comparative 2024-2026 periods. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is disclosed; this is ordinary quarterly earnings reporting, not a special situation. Watch subsequent filings for any M&A or capital actions.
